meta_title: J R Interiors | Painter & Decorator Sheffield
meta_description: J R Interiors is your trusted painter and decorator in Sheffield. Interior and exterior work, free quotes, fully insured. Call 07842 213630 today.
hero_eyebrow: Fully Insured — Free Quotes & No Hidden Costs
hero_subhead: From feature walls to full house renovations, we transform your Sheffield home with expert preparation, premium finishes, and attention to detail.
services_heading: Complete Painting & Decorating Services in Sheffield
services_subhead: Whether you need interior refreshes, exterior protection, or specialist finishes, we handle every job with the same care and precision.

services.title: Interior Painting & Wallpapering
services.desc: Transform your rooms with expert interior painting, feature walls, and professional wallpaper hanging. We prepare surfaces properly and use quality paints that last.

services.title: Exterior Painting & Rendering
services.desc: Protect and refresh your home's exterior with weatherproof paint and rendering work. We handle fascias, soffits, and weatherboarding to keep your property safe from the elements.

services.title: Woodwork & Joinery Finishing
services.desc: Doors, frames, skirting boards, and fitted furniture all painted to a professional finish. We use quality materials and techniques that resist scuffing and wear.

services.title: Textured Coatings & Specialist Finishes
services.desc: Artex removal, polished plaster, lime wash, and decorative effects. Perfect for period properties or creating a distinctive interior look.

services.title: Preparation & Surface Repair
services.desc: Proper prep is the foundation of great results. We fill, sand, and prime all surfaces thoroughly—no shortcuts that lead to peeling or poor finish.

services.title: Residential & Commercial Redecorating
services.desc: From single rooms to multi-property portfolios, we work around your schedule and guarantee minimal disruption. References available on request.

about_pullquote: Good preparation beats rush jobs every single time.
about_para_1: J R Interiors was founded on a simple idea: take time, do it right, and leave every customer with a home they're proud of. With over 15 years in Sheffield, we've built our reputation on honest quotes, reliable timekeeping, and quality finishes that last. Every job is treated as if it's our own home.
about_para_2: We don't cut corners on preparation or materials. Our customers return to us because we listen, we turn up when we say we will, and we stand behind our work. Whether you're refreshing a bedroom or redecorating your whole house, you get the same level of care and craftsmanship.
reviews_heading: What Sheffield Homeowners Say About J R Interiors

reviews.text: Had James paint our hall, stairs and landing. He was on time, tidy, and got it done in two days. Quality finish and really reasonable price. Can't fault him.
reviews.author: Michael T.

reviews.text: We were dreading redecorating the lounge after water damage, but James made the whole thing straightforward. Great prep work, advised us on colours, and the finish is brilliant. Definitely recommend.
reviews.author: Christine W.

reviews.text: Quoted three decorators. J R Interiors came in with a clear, honest quote and beat the others hands down. Work was immaculate, cleaned up properly, and finished ahead of schedule. Will use again for the kitchen.
reviews.author: David P.
